name: Password Input
description: A secret field with an accessible visibility toggle.

anatomy.description: The secret field rendered with type password.
The eye button that flips the field type and reports its state through aria-pressed.

dos: Set autoComplete to new-password or current-password so password managers fill correctly.
State the requirements in the description, not only after a failed submit.
Pair new-password fields with PasswordStrengthMeter when strength matters.
donts: Don't reveal the password by default.
Don't block paste; password managers depend on it.
Don't use it for non-sensitive masked text; masking here is about secrecy.

examples.title: Visibility toggle
examples.description: The eye button exposes its state through aria-pressed.

examples.title: Current password
examples.description: The current-password autocomplete variant used in security settings flows.

guidance.useWhen: The user enters a secret they may want to verify visually.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content is not sensitive; use Input or SearchInput.
guidance.behavior: The visibility toggle reports state through aria-pressed.
guidance.responsive: The toggle stays pinned inside the field at any width.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the field and the visibility toggle.
Toggles password visibility from the eye button.
Edits the secret using native text editing keys.

notes: The visibility toggle reports its state through aria-pressed and keeps an accessible label.
Set autoComplete to new-password or current-password so password managers fill the field.
Inside a Field, descriptions and errors link through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

props.description: Supporting text rendered below the input and linked to it for assistive technology.
props.name: description

props.description: Visible label rendered above the input. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used.
props.name: label

props.description: Called with the new string whenever the value changes.
props.name: onValueChange
